notes.title: April 12th Minor Patch Update
notes.content:
Fixed some known bugs
1. Fixed the bug that the achievement could not be triggered due to the inability to clear the twenty-fourth level of Chapter 1
2. Fixed the bug that the 200-step achievement could not be triggered
3. Fixed the bug that the UI of some devices was displayed abnormally

Please note that if you downloaded and played the game before this announcement, you will need to change your device's save file for this patch to take effect, regardless of whether you delete the game midway. If you downloaded and played after this announcement was posted, please ignore the steps below.
Here's how:
1. Level save deletion, delete the ClassicLevel24 (LevelConfig) .txt file, its possible path is as follows (C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\LocalLow\KaCat Studio\Minimalist Boxes\game_SaveData\ClassicThemeConfig (MapConfig)\ClassicLevel24 (LevelConfig).txt).
2. Delete the achievement archive file, delete the AchievementData folder, it may be pathed as follows (C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\LocalLow\KaCat Studio\Minimalist Boxes\game_SaveData\AchievementData). This file will have no effect on your unlocked achievements, so feel free to delete it just for the patch to take effect.

KaCat Studio
Yours sincerely
